method: Explicit UTF-8 byte sequence replacement only; no line removal, JSON reformatting or newline normalization in copied evidence. Changed files are derivatives, not original bytes.
cleartext_mapping: Retained in separate private delivery area; never committed
source_vs_delivery_metadata: 13 control/run source files frozen and all copied; private processing metadata lives in separate delivery area.
replacement_order: Generate raw UTF-8 token and successive JSON string-content encodings at escape levels0..4; de-duplicate equal variants per category; sort descending by byte length; replace exact occurrences without parsing/reserializing evidence. Nested tool output needed level2 (four backslashes). Per-file levels/counts are in manifest.
nested_JSON_scan: Verification only: parse public JSON, recursively decode string values that are valid JSON, and scan all values and raw escape-level variants for recorded private tokens. Never regenerate evidence bytes through JSON serialization.
